relations.subject: Henry Thomas Colebrooke
relations.evidence: On 1 October 1806, when the Asiatic Society reconvened after its annual break, Colebrooke presented his first two papers as president.

relations.subject: C. P. Brown
relations.evidence: When C. P. Brown submitted his treatise on Telugu prosody for publication by the College of Fort St George in 1827, the fact that he followed Colebrooke’s plan was noted as a point in his favour
